title: Untranscendable order types
summary: We introduce and study a multiplicative analogue of additive indecomposability for linear order types that we call untranscendability, as well as a strengthening that we call $s$-untranscendability. We show that, with the unique exception of the two-point type, every untranscendable type is additively indecomposable, and every $σ$-scattered untranscendable type is strongly indecomposable. Under the Proper Forcing Axiom, every untranscendable Aronszajn type is strongly indecomposable.
